title: owehub
features:
THIS SCRIPT DONT WORK ON XENO OR SOLARA OR ANY LVL 3 EXEC

🎯 Aimlock
Aimlock (lock camera to nearest player)
Aimlock Type: Nearest Player / Nearest Mouse
Smooth Aimlock with adjustable speed (lerp alpha)
Aim Part selection: Head / Torso / Feet
FOV Circle with adjustable size, color, stroke thickness
Rainbow FOV
Aimlock to specific player
Ignore Shielded players
Ignore Lobby players
Wall Check (won't lock through walls)
Ignore Players list
Prioritize Players list
Aimlock Offset X/Y
Keybind support

Silent Aim
Silent Aim (redirects bullets without moving camera)
Silent Aim Part: Head / Torso
FOV Circle (Drawing API) with adjustable size
Center FOV (lock to screen center or mouse)
Wall Check
Max Distance filter
Rainbow FOV Circle
Custom FOV Color
Keybind support
Hooks into BulletHandler module

Auto-Fire (W.I.P)
Automatic shooting at closest target
Adjustable fire delay
Adjustable shoot delay
Wall check integrated
Auto aim + auto shoot comb

👁️ ESP
Name ESP (player name + distance + weapon)
Shielded player indicator (red color)
Outline/Highlight ESP with customizable colors
Outline Fill Color & Transparency
Tracer ESP (Bottom / Middle / Up position)
Skeleton ESP
Rainbow mode for: ESP, Outline, Tracers, Skeleton
Adjustable ESP text size
Rainbow speed control
RGB ASync mode (Forward / Backwards spectrum)

🎮 Character
WalkSpeed slider (20-24)
No Velocity (freeze other players' velocity)
Bunny Hop with adjustable delay + keybind
X-Ray with adjustable transparency

🌍 Visuals
Field of View slider (60-120)
Full Bright
No Fog

⚡ Features
Auto Respawn with adjustable delay
Lobby / Play buttons
Switch to Knife when close to player (adjustable range)
Show knife range sphere with color picker
Mass Open Knife Crates (up to 25)
Mass Open Gun Crates (up to 15)

🎨 Fun
RGB Gun/Knife (Material or Highlight mode)
RGB Speed control
RGB Re-Apply Speed
Force Neon material toggle
RGB ASync with speed and direction control
Custom Hit SFX (sound ID)
Custom Critical Hit SFX (sound ID)
Auto Apply Custom SFX with delay
